title: Duskmourn: House of Horror Promos: card flavor text

entities.name: Rian
entities.description: A former survivor who urges others to split up to cover more ground.

entities.name: Toby, Beastie Befriender
entities.description: A small person who isn't scared because of their large beastie companion Gribble.

entities.name: Gribble
entities.description: Toby's large beastie companion.

entities.name: The Mindskinner
entities.description: A horror that slices away memories, most precious first, until only blank, formless fear remains.

entities.name: Rip
entities.description: A spawn hunter who advises always burning the bodies.

entities.name: Valgavoth
entities.description: A malevolent being who whispers into Marina's ear; he has a lair at the heart of Duskmourn.

entities.name: Marina
entities.description: A person whom Valgavoth whispered to until he was all she could hear.

entities.name: Vicky
entities.description: A person suffering a grievous wound who hears her grandmother's voice telling her to rest.

entities.name: Duskmourn
entities.description: A plane that is a vast, shifting House of horrors, whose rotten heart is Valgavoth's Lair.

entities.name: Razorkin
entities.description: Bloodthirsty stitched horrors of the House, one of which once used a ventriloquist's puppet to terrorize a survivor.

entities.name: Kona, Rescue Beastie
entities.description: A rescue beastie with a heart of gold, a nose for danger, and powerful jaws.

entities.name: Cellarspawn
entities.description: A kind of creature Kona can pulverize with a single snap.

entities.name: Hauntwoods
entities.description: A region where life thrives but follows its own laws, prowled by monstrous creatures.

entities.name: Tyvar Kell
entities.description: A planeswalker who treats the endless monsters as his morning workout.

entities.name: The Wanderer
entities.description: A planeswalker who, with Tyvar, decided to stop running.

entities.name: Farley
entities.description: The former fastest runner on the track team, now an undead sprinter.

entities.name: Marvin, Murderous Mimic
entities.description: A ventriloquist's puppet once used by a razorkin to terrorize a survivor, which now hunts on its own.

entities.name: Balemurk
entities.description: A region of oppressive darkness that spits and boils.

entities.name: Mistmoors
entities.description: A region of once-thriving fields drowned by relentless deluge.

entities.name: Floodpits
entities.description: A region of clear waters choked by the bog.

entities.name: Boilerbilges
entities.description: A region of peaks straining against grasping roots and vines.

entities.name: Valgavoth's Lair
entities.description: The one chamber of the House whose location never changes, the heart of Duskmourn.

events.summary: Valgavoth whispers into Marina's ear until he is all she can hear.
events.quote: Valgavoth whispered into Marina's ear until he was all she could hear.

events.summary: Vicky, grievously wounded and fading, hears her grandmother's voice telling her it's time to rest.
Tyvar and the Wanderer stop running from Valgavoth's onslaught.
events.quote: Tyvar and the Wanderer were done running.

events.summary: Farley, once the track team's fastest runner, has become undead.
events.quote: But no one was cheering anymore.

events.summary: A razorkin once used a ventriloquist's puppet to terrorize a survivor; the puppet, Marvin, now hunts on its own.
events.quote: Now it hunts on its own, with no one pulling its strings.

relations.quote: "Sure, I'm pretty small, but Gribble isn't, so I don't get scared."
Valgavoth whispered into Marina's ear until he was all she could hear.
Tyvar and the Wanderer were done running.

relations.note: A razorkin once used Marvin as a puppet.
relations.quote: a razorkin once picked up a ventriloquist's puppet and used it to terrorize a survivor.
the rotten, rancorous heart of Duskmourn itself.
